restoration_note: This teaching enumerates the Three Cosmic Times of regeneration: (1) First Man's descent into the Deep, contest with the Gate of Darkness, and ascent by the Living Spirit to the Land of Light; (2) the Living Spirit and Mother of Life ordering and establishing the cosmos; (3) the Third Ambassador's revelation, Sin's flight, the depicting of trees and Adam-with-Eve, Jesus's giving of hope, and the final ascent of Panaretos against the bolos at the dissolution. The fills cluster strongly where formulaic parallels recur (descent/ascent verbs, ⲡⲣⲟ ⲛⲛⲁⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ, Mother of Life pairings, ⲡⲁⲛⲇⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ/Panaretos eschatology, ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ idiom, ⲧⲍⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ given to Adam) — these are restored with high confidence. Sections 17.32–17.34 and the dialogue at 17.60–17.67 (the rhetorical comparison of relative duration of the three periods) are too fragmentary for safe restoration and are largely left as low-confidence proposals or marked unrestorable. The Lycopolitan ⲍⲁⲏ→ⲍⲁⲉ shift constrains gap 8 to 'last time'; ⲁⲡⲃⲱⲗⲟⲥ as Panaretos's terminus is restored at 115 from the parallel at line 17.71.
